Profit and Loss Statement — Sub-total

Create subtotals to organize groups of accounts on the profit and loss statement.

Subtotals help structure financial reports for better readability.

Name

Enter the name that will appear as the subtotal label in reports.

This label represents an intermediate sum of accounts grouped together.

Examples: 'Total Operating Expenses', 'Gross Profit', 'Current Assets'.

Subtotals help organize financial reports and calculate meaningful interim totals.

Position

Enter a number to control the order of this subtotal relative to other subtotals and accounts in reports.

Lower numbers appear first, higher numbers appear later in the report.

Use consistent numbering increments (e.g., 10, 20, 30) to allow easy insertion of new items.

Accounts are automatically positioned between subtotals based on their assigned ranges.
